g.text: Nobody else plans capacity months out.
Sequences survey → install → commissionagainst part lead times
Holds grant and compliance paperworkon the job record
Published price per engineer per month
We are not claiming these tools are bad. None of them answers the question an installer asks in January about August.
Heatline capability and price are illustrative; no vendor is named. Comparator: Jobber published pricing, 2026-09-10.
